rows.en: This operation looks like it'll go well.
Let's see what you can do.
With you and me, success is guaranteed.
Honestly, what were you even doing?
Ah, the mission succeeded. Thank goodness.
I'm counting on you in the next mission too.
The main thing is we both made it back safe.
That was impressive flying. I'll take notes.
Maybe you didn't need my support at all.

rows.notes: Whisper no-speech warning; transcript reads naturally, kept.

rows.en: I could do this alone, you know.
Looking forward to working with you.
We're sortieing together. Looking forward to it.
It's an honor to meet such a beautiful person.
Maybe spring has finally come for me too.
It seems you don't trust me very much.
Well then, if you'll excuse me.
Next time I'd like to sortie alone.
Come on, let's get home quickly.
We got through it without a hitch.
Let's work together next time too.
But what a surprise. I had no idea you had this kind of skill.
We both seem to be in good form.
Come on, let's hurry back and go get a meal.
I was mesmerized by how you fight.
How about a match with me after this?
Milia! Watch what I can do!
I never thought I'd get shot down!
So I really was a genius.
I've always wanted a match with you.
What's wrong, Ichijyo? Suddenly getting cold feet?
I won't let you get away!
rows.notes: Transcript has a typo-like ending (nogasu-moru-ka); read as nogasu mono ka.
Referent not shown; kept neutral (no pronoun).

rows.en: Beautiful. Bust about 85. Deceptively slim in clothes, I'd say.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'ki-ase' (sweat); read as kiyase (looks slimmer than one is). No pronoun, referent unclear.

rows.en: Say, if you don't mind, could I get your name and phone number?
Going out in a blaze of glory on the wedding day wouldn't be so bad.
Milia, watch what I can do!
rows.notes: First half is garbled (something about hitting a skin/hide to save the contents); only the second half is clear and matches clip 601.
Whisper has 'overlook' (minogashite); read as a request to keep watching, probably minogasanai-de.

rows.en: I can't let myself lose either.

rows.notes: Zentradi language. Heard 'bibura'; same word as clips 604 and vpz_mil_012 ('debura'); a re-run with Zentradi words as a hint gave 'deburan'. Zentradi words from the film's lexicon (ja.wikipedia 'Zentradi' language section; gansaito1.hatenablog.jp 2016-09-14 word list): deburan = enemy. Hit-reaction slot (012).
